purpose: Finish the pending local launcher using structured readiness, responsive browser handoff, cancellable signal ownership and one actual listener.
findings: Synchronous browser-helper execution blocked the same Node event loop that serves the local UI.
The launcher scraped exact terminal prose to authorize browser handoff and rejected asynchronous handoff promises.
A separate probe reserved and released a port before preflight, leaving a bind race and redundant listener ownership.
The pending recovery instructions advised opening a URL after the server had already closed on handoff failure.
implementation: Replace terminal-output scraping with a single onReady callback after HTTP readiness. The launcher independently validates the loopback origin.
Use shell-free asynchronous execFile with a bounded output buffer, timeout and AbortSignal. OS acceptance is reported as a browser request, not proof of a rendered page.
Subscribe to termination before readiness output/handoff and dispose subscriptions on failure. Cancellation stops pending handoff without a false success message.
Remove the separate port probe; a null requested port binds the actual listener once on port zero after preflight, then validates its assigned unprivileged port.
Admit the canonical site before launcher work. Add launcher commands and current README instructions.
Move pending runbook/UI-gate assertions intact into acquisition-playwright-gate.test.js. That file, the synthetic runbook and UI gate edits remain uncommitted pending integration review.

regressionsBeforeFix.scope: launcher; synchronous HTTP starvation boundary and termination during asynchronous handoff
